correctness.rationale: The full increasing-path complex equals the unaugmented q-subset complex. Three explicit q-tensor identities show its all-size short-bar decomposition. Truncating the empty subset shifts a unique length-three bar to length two. The two index homologies follow from kernels/images on bars. For the deleted source-to-sink arc, only the degree-one allowed path is removed; obstructions in degrees two and three are nonzero, and x, dx, d^2x split off a length-three acyclic direct summand for every n>=4. All higher dimensions are covered by the induction. Exact checks over two characteristic-not-three fields for n<=9 corroborate, but do not constitute, the proof.
